notes.title: 🥩 Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Steam Community Items are available as of now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807843/0d18075e1f90afa5fd48958df9b2757a39a1720f.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Meat Boy lovers and puzzlers!

We have some good news today! You, who have spent hour after hour puzzling your way through Dr. Fetus' ruthless test chambers, will now receive an additional reward: as of now Steam Community Items are available for [b]Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine[/b]!

[b]These consist of:[/b]
[list][*] 5 Emoticons
[*] 5 Profile Backgrounds
[*] 7 Trading Cards
[*] Badge (5 Levels + Foil Badge)[/list]
We hope you like them and collect them all.

Happy Meat Grinding Thursday to all of you!
Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228030/Dr_Fetus_Mean_Meat_Machine/

notes.title: 🥩 Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Demo got updated! 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807843/63a123d611c12409459b45b80f102b568df43c4a.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

We are really blown away by the number of you folks that played our [b]Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine[/b] demo! As well as by the massive amount of feedback - thank you so much for that! ❤️

You also brought up a number of issues in the demo, and we are working on fixing those at the moment. We recently updated the demo build, and that's the fixes/additions/improvements that come with the update:

[list][*] Fixed endless chains bug
[*] Added 180° rotation when stuck between two columns
[*] Better distinguishable preview icons
[*] Chains now resolve after finishing a level
[*] Updated missile FX
[*] Updated breakaway tiles FX
[*] Additional minor fixes and tweaks[/list]
Thanks for pointing those out! And if you liked the demo, please follow and wishlist the game, this would really help us a lot! ːsteamhappyː

Till then and have a great week everyone!
Mark & the Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Team

notes.title: 🥩 Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Demo live in the Super Meat Boy Franchise Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370473/4cfbb5bf395ae8a8c68bf818dd1e960b2731d36d.jpg[/img]

Greetings again Meat Boy friends and puzzlers!

And welcome to the very first ever "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/thunderfulpublishing/sale/super-meat-boy-franchise-sale][b]Super Meat Boy Franchise Sale[/b][/url]" here on Steam - featuring the freshly announced [b]Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

[b]And that's what you can expect from our little franchise sale:[/b]

[list][*] The first ever chance to get your fingers on [b]Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine[/b] with the just released demo!
[*] High discounts for [b]Super Meat Boy[/b] and [b]Super Meat Boy Forever[/b] - including the corresponding DLCs of course!
[*] Some good old Super Meat Boy vibes
[*] Our [b]eternal and endless gratitude[/b] for visiting the franchise sale page!
[*] Julian and Tim competing against each other in playing the [b]Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine[/b] demo in the broadcast - under the wary eyes of dev Mark (great fun!)[/list]
And that's it. We hope you all have a good time with our beloved Meat Boy and his nemesis Dr. Fetus!

See you all in the broadcast, friends!
Tommy, Team Meat & the Dr. Fetus Team
